book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: 1 Corinthians Saint Paul, Corinth gwizhit Gwik'injiighit Nąįį Tr'ookit ts'ą' Ch'adąąntł'oo

content: Shik'it t'akhwa'in, Christ vik'it t'ishi'in gwik'it.
Nats'ąą Tr'igiinkhii Zheh gwizhit Deegwehee'yaa
Jidii geenookhwałchya' gwik'it dinjii ǫhłįį ts'ą' shanoondaii geh'an gwinzii t'akhwa'in nakhwaihnyąą.

Gaa jii kwaii gaakhwandaii gwat'oohchy'aa, Christ, dinjii nąįį datthak ts'ą' k'eegwaadhat ąįį gwik'it dinjii nąįį chan daga'at ts'ą' k'eedeegwagwaadhat t'oonchy'aa, ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa chan Christ ts'ą' k'eegwaadhat.
Ąįįts'ą' dinjii ts'eh naa'aii tr'igiinkhii zheh gwizhit khagidiinjii ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Eenjit Ginkhii t'ee Christ hił'ee kwaa t'oonchy'aa.

Ąįįts'ą' tr'injaa viki' noołjik kwaa ts'ą' tr'igiinkhii zheh gwahtsii gwiizhit khadigiinjii ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ginjik eegwaandak t'ee dakai' yeenjihił'ee kwaa t'inchy'aa, jii tr'injaa t'ee tr'injaa viki' kal gwiriłtsąįį haa nihk'it t'oonchy'aa.

Tr'injaa diki' noołjik kwaa ąįį diki' datthak khat'ii ts'ąįį gwinzii akwat tr'injaa diki' kal gwahtsii akwat diki' khat'ii t'ee veenjit oozhii gwanlii t'oonchy'aa. Ąįįts'ą' diki' noołjik ts'ąįį nizįį.

Dinjii ąįį diki' noołjik gwat'aahchy'aa kwaa, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa k'it t'inchy'aa ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vich'eegwąhndit nilii geh'an, gaa tr'injaa ąįį dinjii vich'eegwahdrii k'it t'inchy'aa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa yiltsąįį.
Dinjii ąįį tr'injaa ts'an tr'iłtsąįį kwaa gaa tr'injaa ąįį dinjii ts'an tr'iłtsąįį t'oonchy'aa.
Dinjii ąįį tr'injaa eenjit tr'iłtsąįį kwaa, gaa tr'injaa ąįį dinjii eenjit tr'iłtsąįį t'oonchy'aa.

Ąįį kwaii geh'an zheekat gwich'in nąįį diik'aahtii ts'ą' tr'injaa khagidiinjii akwat Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa viginjik eech'ǫąąhtan dąį' diki' noołjik gwat'aahchy'aa, gwik'iighai' zheekat gwich'in nąįį tr'injaa Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa k'eegwahthat giiyaaheendaii geenjit.
Ąįį googaa, jii nankat gwarandaii ts'ą' gwik'injiriighit, tr'injaa ąįį dinjii t'injyąhchy'aa, ts'ą' dinjii chan tr'injaa t'injigahahchy'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' tr'injaa, dinjii ts'an tr'iłtsąįį, ąįį gwik'it dinjii ąįį tr'injaa ts'an vagoodlit ts'ą' Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa jidii datthak iłtsąįį ts'ą' gwizhrįh ninlii t'oonchy'aa.
Nakhwan nakhwakhai' geeninjich'ohthat, tr'injaa viki' noołjik kwaa ts'ą' dinjii tee gwa'an Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'ą' khagidiinjii dąį' gwinzii t'ii'in lee t'ii'in?
Dinjii vik'iighai' ninjyaa dąį' jyaa doonchy'aa kwaa gaagwiindaii, geh'an gwa'oozhii gwanlii,
gaa tr'injaa vik'iighai' ninjyaa dąį' gwinzii viyiichy'a', ąįį vik'iighai' viki' noołjik geenjit t'inchy'aa.
Gaa geenjit ch'izheedahol'ee nohthan ji', diikhwan akwat Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vitr'igiinkhii zheh kwaii jyaa jyąhts'ą' ginjik eech'oorahtan kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Ninjigwadhat
Jii deekhwa'in nakhwaihnyąą gaa sheenjit gwinzii t'akhwa'ya' kwaa, nijin Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa deekhadhoh'ee geenjit tr'igiinkhii zheh khaihłan neekhwadal dąį', gwalak gwizhrįh gwinzii t'akhwa'in.
Jii tr'ookit nakhwats'ą' gihihkhyaa yiihthan, khaihłan neekhwadal geenjit nakhwats'į' t'igiinchy'aa ąįį deeginyąą gwalak gwik'injihkhit.
Kheihłak ǫhłįį kwaa t'ee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vik'iighai', nakhwatee juu gwinzii t'ii'in nąįį gwizhrįh gogweheechy'aa geenjit t'igii'in.
Nijin jyąhts'ą' khaihłan neekhwadal dąį' ninjigwadhat gwinzii nǫhjii t'akhwa'in kwaa.
Ch'izhii nąįį ch'ihee'aa gwehkįį nakhwan zhrįh ch'oh'aa ąįįts'ą', ch'izhii nąįį zhit gwiłts'ik gwiizhit ch'izhii nąįį chan ch'inigiinjik.

Nijin ch'ihin'aa ts'ą' ch'ininjyaa geenjit nizheh goo'aii? Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vitr'igiinkhii zheh nihił'ee kwaa ts'ą' dinjii neeshraahchy'aa nąįį chan ts'an oozhii ąhtsii! Jii geenjit deenahaihjyaa? Nahooł'ee shǫįįnyąą? Duuyeh gwik'it gwanlii.
K'eegwaadhat vats'an jidii geenoohałchyaa oodhiijik ąįį nats'an ałtsii, K'eegwaadhat Jesus zhat khaa gwantł'eerahahchįį gwehkįį dąį' łųhchy'aa oonjik.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'ą' “Mahsį',” nyąą, ts'ą' łeeyiiłnaii ts'ą' jyaa nyąą, “Jii t'ee shatthąį', nakhweenjit Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa antł'eehałchaa. Jii shineehoondaii eenjit jyaa dakhwa'in.”

Ąįį gwik'it ch'igin'al tł'ęę chųų tyah oonjik ts'ą' jyaa nyąą “Jii chųų tyah t'ee Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa deehee'yaa nyąą gwik'it t'iizhik ąįį k'eejit neegwiłtsąįį ts'ą' jii shadaa nakhweenjit gwats'an hahtsyaa, nijin khwanįį dąį' shininjich'ohtthat.”
Nijin jii łųhchy'aa oh'aa ts'ą' jii chųų tyah ts'an jak chų' khwanįį nyąą dąį' K'eegwaadhat k'ineeheedik gwats'ą' jaghaii niindhat geegahoondak geenjit t'akhwa'in.

Nakhwatee ch'ihłak K'eegwaadhat hił'ee kwaa ts'ą' yichųų tyah ts'an jak chų' dinįį gwiizhit yiłųhchy'aa chan a'aa ji' t'ee Christ dee'ya' K'eegwaadhat vatthąį' ts'ą' vadaa haa nehts'į' tr'agwaanduu t'akhwa'in t'oonchy'aa.
Ąįįts'ą' gwinzii Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa vandee ts'ą' jidii dinjii ǫhłįį gaakhwandaii tł'ęę hee K'eegwaadhat vihłuhchy'aa oh'aa ts'ą' vichųų tyah ts'an jak chų' khwanįį.
Nijin K'eegwaadhat vats'an łųhchy'aa oh'aa ts'ą' jak chų' akhwanįį gwahoo'ee kwaa dąį', łųhchy'aa oh'aa ts'ą' jak chų' akhwanįį t'ee gwitee tr'anakhwarilii t'oonchy'aa.
Ąįį geh'an nakhwatee lęįį nąįį iłts'ik ts'ą' goot'aii kwaa ts'ą' goolat nąįį niindhat.
Gwinzii adak'arahaanjii ji', Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa gwitee tr'idiiniheelyaa kwaa t'oonchy'aa.
Gaa jii nankat an tr'iheelyaa kwaa geenjit K'eegwaadhat khaiinjich'idiinahthat ts'ą' gwitee tr'idiiniinlii.
Ąįįts'ą' nijin K'eegwaadhat ninjigwadhat oh'aa dąį', shachaa nąįį nihłeenjit nagwadhoo'in.

Łyaa nakhwazhit gwiłts'ik ji', nakhwazheh gwa'an ch'oh'aa, jyąhts'ą' ji' khaihłan neekhwadal dąį', Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa gwitee tr'anakhwahahchyaa kwaa geenjit. Ch'adanh gwa'an deegwii'in ąįį nakhwaa nineeshizhii ji' shrigwihihłyaa.

footnotes.text: Tr'ookit tr'injaa Eve oaazhii, Adam vits'ik ts'an iltsąįį.
